title: Orthogonal Scores and Double/Debiased Machine Learning for Possibly Misspecified GMM
abstract: arXiv:2611.17578v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop Neyman orthogonal scores for GMM models that remain valid when the moment conditions may fail to hold. Existing score constructions typically require the moment conditions to hold exactly, which may fail in over-identified models, where the number of moment functions exceeds the number of parameters. We construct \emph{misspecification-robust} orthogonal score that has a closed form; it is the conventional orthogonal score plus adjustment terms, for the estimation of the Jacobian and of the weighting matrix, which are proportional to the population moment and vanish under correct specification. translated_title: 针对可能误设GMM模型的正交得分与双重/去偏机器学习方法
translated_abstract: 我们为GMM模型开发了Neyman正交得分，即使矩条件可能不成立时依然有效。现有的得分构造通常要求矩条件精确成立，这在过度识别模型（即矩函数数量超过参数数量）中可能失效。我们构造了具有闭式表达式的误设稳健正交得分；它等于传统正交得分加上用于估计雅可比矩阵和权重矩阵的调整项，这些调整项与总体矩成比例，并在正确设定下消失。矩函数可以依赖非参数或机器学习方法进行第一步估计，我们证明双重/去偏机器学习（DML）结合所提出的得分与交叉拟合，可为低维GMM估计目标提供一致有效的统计推断，而传统DML标准误在矩条件误设时会不一致。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种具有闭式表达式的误设稳健正交得分方法，即使GMM矩条件不成立，结合双重/去偏机器学习与交叉拟合仍能实现一致有效的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes closed-form misspecification-robust orthogonal scores for GMM, enabling uniformly valid inference with double/debiased machine learning and cross-fitting even when moment conditions may fail to hold.
